soundness_lemma: D is a bijection of the frozen physical schedule space preserving resource conflicts, the equality of the two MC orientations, global interleaving, and layer labels.  It swaps the two CSS error sectors, maps residual order position k identically, maps zero syndrome to zero syndrome, and maps stabilizer span to stabilizer span.  Therefore the D-image of every reviewed order exclusion and exact selector exclusion is sound; translation closure of the missing image sets follows from D T_delta D=T_-delta.
